title: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
description: Sell goods for wholesalers or manufacturers to businesses or groups of individuals. Work requires substantial knowledge of items sold.

projection.title: Sales representatives, wholesale and manufacturing, except technical and scientific products

tasks.text: Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, product uses, and credit terms.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product questions answered from knowledge base

dwas.name: Answer customer questions about goods or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Recommend products to customers, based on customers' needs and interests.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Product recommendations need customer context and persuasion

dwas.name: Recommend products or services to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Estimate or quote prices, credit or contract terms, warranties, and delivery dates.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Estimates costs/terms; human negotiates and commits

dwas.name: Estimate costs or terms of sales.
Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Consult with clients after sales or contract signings to resolve problems and to provide ongoing support.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product-use advice is largely informational with review

dwas.name: Advise customers on the use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Prepare sales contracts and order forms.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft contracts; legal terms human-owned

dwas.name: Prepare sales or other contracts.

tasks.text: Provide customers with product samples and catalogs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically distributing samples and literature

dwas.name: Distribute promotional literature or samples to customers.

tasks.text: Monitor market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI extracts product specs and summarizes

dwas.name: Monitor market conditions or trends.
Study product information to acquire professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, keeping sales records, and filing expense account reports.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured sales records via tools

dwas.name: Prepare financial documents, reports, or budgets.
Maintain records of sales or other business transactions.

tasks.text: Contact regular and prospective customers to demonstrate products, explain product features, and solicit orders.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical explanation to customers needs live interaction

dwas.name: Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

dwas.name: Demonstrate products to consumers.
Contact current or potential customers to promote products or services.

tasks.text: Identify prospective customers by using business directories, following leads from existing clients, participating in organizations and clubs, and attending trade shows and conferences.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI analyzes market data to identify prospects

dwas.name: Identify potential customers.

tasks.text: Negotiate with retail merchants to improve product exposure, such as shelf positioning and advertising.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Price negotiation needs live give-and-take

dwas.name: Negotiate prices or other sales terms.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Check stock levels and reorder merchandise as necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Merchandise purchasing aided; human owns buying decisions

dwas.name: Purchase stocks of merchandise or supplies.
Monitor inventories of products or materials.

tasks.text: Plan, assemble, and stock product displays in retail stores, or make recommendations to retailers regarding product displays, promotional programs, and advertising.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Campaign coordination needs human judgment and relationships

dwas.name: Set up merchandise displays.
Stock products or parts.
Coordinate sales campaigns.

tasks.text: Negotiate details of contracts and payments.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Price negotiation needs live give-and-take

dwas.name: Negotiate prices or other sales terms.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Prepare drawings, estimates, and bids that meet specific customer needs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Estimates costs/terms; human negotiates and commits

dwas.name: Estimate costs or terms of sales.
Prepare drawings or diagrams of products or services.
Develop proposals for current or prospective customers.

tasks.text: Obtain credit information about prospective customers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Credit data screening against criteria, human decides

dwas.name: Verify customer credit information.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Sending digital materials automatable; physical mailing human

dwas.name: Send information, materials or documentation.
Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Arrange and direct delivery and installation of products and equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can arrange deliveries; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Arrange delivery of goods or services.
